title: Source project manifest (workbench.sources.json)
description: Editor completion only. src/cli/domain/source-projects.ts is authoritative and fails closed; node bin/app source check also rejects unknown references, cycles and a flat src project next to src/<name> projects.

name.description: Unique; also the #<name>/* import alias of a library project.

kind.description: Template in templates/sources/<kind>; plugin and companion use the browser TypeScript base, cli the node base.

path.description: src/<name>, or src for the only project of a legacy flat layout.

references.description: Projects this one may import; they must form a DAG.

platform.description: Library projects only: the TypeScript base (default node).

include.description: Replaces the kind's default tsconfig include globs.

compilerOptions.description: Extra tsconfig compiler options; rootDir, declarationDir, tsBuildInfoFile and composite are derived.

extraReferences.description: Repository-relative tsconfig files referenced after the project references.

gateExemptions.description: Gates that deliberately do not cover this project, each with its reason.
